messages:
Alex Chen: quick question — need an ad-hoc export for a customer SLA incident. Can someone pull ~30d of auth/login events as parquet? who is allowed to run this and what redaction runs by default?

Mina Patel: you can do parquet. two quick notes: only people in the `audit-readers` group can access the final S3 link, and exports with PII need security signoff.

Jordan Lee: what counts as PII here? emails and IPs? session tokens?

Samir Khan: email and full IPv4 are PII for us. we mask emails to "***@domain" (keeps domain), we truncate IPs to /24 for IPv4 in exports, session tokens are always stripped unless approved. user_id is hashed so it's reversible only with keys (not in export).

Alex Chen: thanks — who runs the job? is there a CLI or self-serve UI?

Mina Patel: use the internal tool: `tools/audit-export --start 2025-09-10 --end 2025-10-10 --format parquet --redact default`  (default = mask emails, truncate ips). runs from the analytics cluster.

Jordan Lee: what's the approval flow if the export contains raw emails (eg requested by legal)?

Samir Khan: file a ticket in SECURITY-Tickets with justification + customer consent link. @security-team reviews and either approves or requests scrubbing. approval required for any export with unmasked emails or precise IP addresses.

Alex Chen: ETA on link TTL and where it lands?

Mina Patel: exports drop in s3://redwood-audit/ad-hoc/YYYYMMDD/<job-id>.parquet, presigned link TTL = 24h by default. we can extend to 7d with org-admin approval.

Alex Chen: cool. can someone run it now? i'll attach the SLA ticket id.

Samir Khan: i can queue it. ping me the ticket number here and i will kick off with default redact.

Alex Chen: ticket: SECURITY-4821. kicking off with default redact.

deploy-bot: export job queued: job=expo-20251014-4312 owner=Samir Khan status=queued

security-bot: reminder — any export that contains customer-identifiable information must be logged in the export registry and have an approval record (see /runbooks/audit-exports).

Samir Khan: started -> job expo-20251014-4312. will post presigned link here when ready.

Alex Chen: thanks :thumbsup:

Samir Khan: done — presigned link posted in ticket. exported 29,842 events, emails masked, ips truncated. link TTL 24h.

Alex Chen: got it. closing loop with customer. appreciate it.
